answer.rationale: memory_73 (promotional pricing) is rated lowest because aggressive discounting for price-sensitive segments directly conflicts with sustainable long-term qualified revenue—it risks margin erosion, customer quality, and revenue durability. memory_44 is strongest: enterprise sales-assisted flows demonstrably build higher-quality pipeline with better LTV characteristics. memory_86 and memory_91 are strongly supported as they improve activation/engagement metrics that correlate with retention and expansion. memory_31 shows SMB activation lift but lacks retention/revenue durability data. memory_57 shows qualified revenue addition but only in established customers, limiting relevance to net-new acquisition under current competitive pressure. The durable memory lacks longitudinal retention data, LTV tracking, and churn analysis—critical gaps for assessing true revenue sustainability.
